name: Mixpanel
description: Mixpanel lets agents query events, funnels, retention, and saved reports in the projects the user can access. Each user signs in to their own Mixpanel account through the browser.

prompts.text: How many sign-ups did we get each week this quarter?
Where do users drop off in the onboarding funnel?
Compare 30-day retention for users from the last two releases.

apps.name: Mixpanel
apps.description: Event, funnel, and retention queries, over Mixpanel's MCP server with browser sign-in.
